purpose: Qualify the logical state representation across the unsaturated/saturated boundary before extending RossFast face tables or implementing a saturation-crossing timestep.

architecture_hypothesis.persistent_physical_state: one pressure_head_cm value per soil control volume
architecture_hypothesis.worker_numerical_state: Ross-style mixed variable: effective saturation/water-content coordinate for h<0 and pressure-head coordinate for h>=0, plus a trial mode mask
architecture_hypothesis.separation_rule: The solver's mixed dependent variable is numerical scratch and is not required to be the persisted restart coordinate.
architecture_hypothesis.mode_rule: UNSATURATED for h<0; SATURATED for h>=0. The h=0 boundary belongs deterministically to SATURATED.
architecture_hypothesis.reason: E0 proved theta and K are noninjective in the saturated regime, while pressure head remains a single physical coordinate on both sides of h=0.

hydraulic_scope.note: This gate uses source constitutive functions directly. It does not claim that the existing C1R face table is valid above h=-1 cm.

hard_tests.persistent_head_to_worker_to_head_roundt: all finite witnesses; unsaturated inverse must reproduce h within absolute 1e-8 cm or relative 1e-11, saturated branch must be exact binary64 pass-through
hard_tests.checkpoint_restore_identity: serializing and restoring persistent head alone must reproduce mode, theta and worker coordinate deterministically
hard_tests.storage_delta_representation_independenc: for every transition pair, theta(h1)-theta(h0) computed from persistent heads must equal the same delta obtained after worker encode/decode within 2e-15 volumetric theta
hard_tests.no_switch_storage_correction: transition accounting is only theta_end-theta_start; no separate saturation-mode storage term is allowed
hard_tests.forward_reverse_storage_antisymmetry: paired forward/reverse transitions must sum to zero within 2e-15 volumetric theta
hard_tests.rollback_identity: a rejected crossing trial must leave the committed persistent head, derived theta and mode bitwise/numerically unchanged
hard_tests.boundary_mode_is_deterministic: h=0 is SATURATED for every material

selection_rule.pass: Select UNIFIED_HEAD_PERSISTENT_STATE_WITH_ROSS_MIXED_WORKER_VARIABLES as the E-line state architecture candidate.
selection_rule.fail: Do not select a persistent state layout; reconcile mapping or constitutive semantics before face/transition implementation.
selection_rule.performance_nonclaim: Selection is based on physical injectivity, transaction/restart determinism and representation-independent storage, not an assumed runtime advantage.

transaction_rules: Committed state is never mutated by encode/decode or trial construction.
Trial mode masks and mixed variables belong to worker scratch until commit.
A committed crossing publishes only the accepted pressure head; theta and mode are derived from that committed state.
Rollback discards all trial mixed state without needing a compensating water correction.
explicit_nonclaims: E1 does not qualify Ross timestep algebra through saturation.
E1 does not qualify face fluxes for -1<h<=0 or saturated faces.
E1 does not qualify compressible saturated storage; the current base fixture treats theta as plateaued at theta_s for h>=0.
E1 does not qualify groundwater, prescribed-head boundaries, heterogeneity, macropores, Class-B hydraulics or MultiSWAP performance.
E1 does not change physical retention or conductivity laws.
